serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin Mrs. Fisher: I know exactly why you came here. You: You do? Mrs. Fisher: It looked like you made huge progress the last time. I think it will be all over soon. You: Thank God. Any more and people in my environment would start to notice. Mrs. Fisher: It will be fun when you get your memories back. Be sure to tell me all the fucked up things you saw and did there. You: I surely will. Mrs. Fisher: Here you go and good luck. You: Inhales
